name: Nasiruddin Patwary
role: Coordinator in Students Against Discrimination and post-2024 youth political organizer
contribution: He is associated with Students Against Discrimination's coordination network during July-August 2024 and later with youth political organizing and state-reform discussion after the uprising.
context: Students Against Discrimination, the distributed coordination structures of the July-August 2024 movement, and post-uprising youth political organization and reform discourse.
